title: Chapter 500 - 500 Gift; Choice! (1)
content:
Chapter 500 - 500 Gift; Choice! (1)

Chapter 500 - 500 Gift; Choice! (1)

500 Gift; Choice! (1)

Tens of thousands for a bag?

A bracelet?

They were gonna go inside and shop themselves?

Where would they get so much money?

Liu Qianqian was about to speak.

“You’re all students from a famous university,” Wan Fei said. “You’ll definitely have a high salary in the future. Even if you don’t buy these things, you can take a look first. You can buy them later!

“It’s rare to come to Barney, so it would be a pity if you didn’t take a look.

“Your professor must have a high salary! If he’s not with you, he might have gone to a luxury store. He might even buy you some luxury gifts… Hehehe.”

When she finished speaking, her entire body was shaking with laughter.

Prestigious university students who would get high salaries after this?

When she was studying, Wan Fei did have that opinion.

However, after graduating and entering society…

She had long thrown this opinion to the back of her mind.

Even graduates from famous universities only had a salary of 10,000 yuan.

Her husband’s company hired university students for a few thousand yuan a month.

University students were completely worthless now.

As for saying that their professor had a high salary, had gone shopping in luxury stores, and might even buy them luxury gifts… She was joking!

This was because Wan Fei had a certain understanding of the salary of a university professor. It was only 20,000 to 30,000 yuan a month.

How could such a measly salary be enough to buy luxury goods?

Not to mention luxury gifts!

The reason why Wan Fei said so much and insisted that Liu Qianqian and the others go to the luxury stores with her was just to show off.

Back in school, Liu Qianqian relied on her excellent grades and beautiful looks to become a campus belle.

Now, Wan Fei wanted to let Liu Qianqian know that good grades were useless, and so was being pretty… In the end, none of them could compare to her!

She wanted to enjoy the thrill of stepping on Liu Qianqian. She wanted to see Liu Qianqian look up at her.

…

When Liu Qianqian and the others heard Wan Fei’s words, their reactions were different.

They all nodded.

Their professor had a high salary?

Well, that was for sure!

For the past two days, they had been on a luxurious private jet and were picked up by a Rolls-Royce motorcade.

They were staying in the presidential suites of the Shangri-La Hotel…

All of them could verify this point.

In addition, they would just be browsing through the luxury stores. It did not seem like much.

Wan Fei did not pay much attention to Liu Qianqian’s thoughts. She held her hand and walked toward the Cartier store in front of her.

“Welcome to Cartier!” The graceful fair-skinned attendant at the door said in fluent English, “May I know what you need?”

Wan Fei said in broken English, “Can you speak Chinese?”

“Of course, I can,” the attendant said in somewhat awkward Chinese.

As Hua Nation became more and more powerful, and Lin Fan made great achievements in mathematics, chemistry, biology, physics, and other fields, the Chinese language had become one of the must-have languages for service staff in many international cities to learn.

“I’m looking for a necklace.”

The fair-skinned attendant sized up Wan Fei’s clothes and could tell at a glance that most of her clothes were from low-end brands.

Although the bracelet was from Chanel and the bag was from LV, they were only the lowest-end products of Chanel and LV.

The fair-skinned attendant immediately understood Wan Fei’s financial ability.

Hence, she brought her to the lower-range products.

It had to be said that the fair-skinned attendant had good eyesight.

She took out a necklace and said, “The main body of this necklace is made of platinum and inlaid with ten diamonds. It’s very beautiful.”

“Ten diamonds! Oh, great!” Wan Fei asked, “How much?”

“6,122 euros,” the fair-skinned attendant said.

Wan Fei immediately praised, “More than 6,000 euros. It’s only about 40,000 yuan when converted. It’s so beautiful and so cheap… I’ll buy it!”

Then, she rubbed against the middle-aged man beside her and said, “Hubby, help me put it on.”

“Alright.” The middle-aged man felt a little pained, but he still replied agreeably.

After Wan Fei put on the necklace, she felt that her entire person was glowing, as if she had become a princess or queen. She felt incomparably noble.

“Liu Qianqian, hurry up and buy something too!” she said with a smile. “This is a Cartier diamond necklace, and there are ten diamonds inlaid in it! It’s only 40,000 yuan. If it was in Hua Nation, it might be 100,000 yuan!

“The more we buy now, the more we earn. Hurry up and buy something!”

As she spoke, she deliberately showed off her Cartier necklace, Chanel bracelet, and LV bag…

Wan Fei wanted to see Liu Qianqian’s envious and admiring gaze!

Liu Qianqian was about to speak…

At this moment, there was the sound of brisk footsteps outside.

A tall and handsome man strolled in.

It was Lin Fan.

The blonde attendant standing at the door sized Lin Fan up and said in fluent English, “Welcome.”

That was because the blonde attendant saw Lin Fan holding several Vacheron Constantin watch boxes in his hands.

One had to know…

Vacheron Constantin was a top luxury watch. Any one of them would cost tens of thousands of euros!

Moreover, from the appearance of the boxes that Lin Fan was carrying, they were not low-end models. They were high-end models that cost more than 100,000 euros!
